story.title: Welcome to Pratiksha's Craft
story.body: Pratiksha's Craft is a studio of chenille stem crafts — the authentic name for pipe-cleaner art. Every bouquet, flower pot, hair clip, Shubh Labh hanging, and festive piece is twisted by hand from fuzzy chenille stems. Soft, sculptural, and made to last for years without water.

why.title: Handcrafted
why.body: Every bloom is twisted by hand from chenille stems — no machines, no shortcuts.

why.title: Everlasting
why.body: These flowers never need water. They stay as they were gifted, for years.

why.title: Pipe-cleaner art
why.body: The authentic craft name for pipe cleaners: soft, sculptural yarn wrapped on wire, colourfast and lasting.

why.title: Personal note
why.body: Add a handwritten message at checkout. We tuck it into every parcel.

faqs.question: What are chenille stems?
faqs.answer: Chenille stems are the authentic craft name for pipe cleaners — soft, fuzzy yarn wrapped around a flexible wire. We twist them by hand into flowers, décor, and accessories that last.

faqs.question: Are the flowers completely handmade?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every piece is twisted by hand from chenille stems. No machines, no shortcuts — just time and craft.

faqs.question: Do they need water?
faqs.answer: No. These blooms are everlasting. Dust them gently if needed. They will not wilt.

faqs.question: Can I request a custom colour or size?
faqs.answer: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp with a photo or colour preference. Handmade pieces can often be made to order.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Within India, deliveries usually take 5–8 business days. Each piece is packed with care and shipped securely.

faqs.question: What is the return policy?
faqs.answer: Returns are accepted for in-transit damage reported within 24 hours of delivery with an uncut unboxing video. Write to us on Instagram or email.
